run_toplev_hook_before_job: run the Toplev hook before_job method to collect toplev counters for a benchmark job
run_toplev_hook_after_job: run the Toplev hook after_job method to terminate background toplev processes after a benchmark job
start_background_toplev: start a background toplev process with a specified duration and output file path
configure_toplev_options: configure Toplev hook options with custom args binary path and background mode settings
create_toplev_benchmark_metrics: create benchmark metrics directory and output paths for Toplev hook data collection
